player_prompt.intro:
Kcemm ad tili Player {player_id} deg urar n Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Asaru-ik s '{symbol}'.
Tafyala s tɣzi n usrag (s tiddi, s tama, neɣ s tɣzi n usrag).
Ma yekcemm kraḍ s tɣzi, at-rzeg.
Ssufeɣ-d iman-ik s tseɣna '[4]' akken ad tesɛeddi asaru-ik deg tɣzi 4.
Akka Player {player_id}, d asaru-ik '{symbol}' ma d ameddakel-ik '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ⵓⵔ ⵉⴳⵉ ⵓⴽⵛⵓⵎ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵎⵓⵜⵜⴳ. ⵙⵔⵙ "[cell]".

game_action.placed: Anemhal {player_id} yenṭa aseɛdu nnes ({symbol}) deg teɣzi {cell}.
